remarks: Stunning 3 bedroom, 2 full bath in East Norwalk!! - Totally updated kitchen with white cabinetry, quartz counters, stainless steel appliances, recessed lighting, and a large island! - Open and flowing layout on the main level features a light & bright living room with fireplace + dining room off of kitchen - Primary bedroom on main level with en-suite bathroom - 2nd floor features 2 additional bedrooms and an updated bathroom - Hardwood floors throughout! - Great basement for lots of storage space + walk-up attic for even more storage! - Large & private patio features outdoor shower, perfect for summer! - Private back yard area + 1 car detached garage - Great location at the end of the street - Short bike ride to the beach and all the attractions East Norwalk offers, including multiple restaurants and Metro North train!!
